resource.title: Cornell CS5412 Topics in Cloud Computing（Fall 2022，含逐讲 syllabus、阅读与课堂录像）
resource.covers: 课程主页公开逐讲 syllabus（每讲有要点说明、必读论文与录像链接）。内容沿云平台展开：云的经济性与规模成本、数据中心硬件与容错、分片与数据放置、hypervisor 虚拟化（Xen）与容器、托管微服务与“弹性池”、函数服务器（serverless/function-as-a-service）、云上的复制与一致性问题、IoT/边缘接入，覆盖 IaaS/PaaS、弹性、编排/托管服务与成本模型；多租户只在按租户隔离与计价处提及。

courses.prereq_text: CS5412 assumes that you have a solid background doing systems programming and are comfortable writing small amounts of code in C# or Python or a similar language ... CS4414 is an ideal [background], but some people would have taken operating systems, distributed systems, networking, database systems.

For undergraduates: CS 40 (Machine Structure & Assembly Language Programming). Though not required, having taken CS 111 (Operating Systems), CS 112 (Networking), or CS 117 (Internet-scale distributed systems) will help significantly.

extra_prereqs.evidence: Cornell CS5412 FAQ：假定有扎实的系统编程背景，能写 C#/Python 之类的小程序
Tufts CS 118 对本科生要求 CS 40（Machine Structure & Assembly Language Programming）
Tufts CS 118：学过 CS 111 Operating Systems 会“help significantly”；Cornell CS5412 也把操作系统课列为可接受的背景来源
Tufts CS 118：CS 117 Internet-scale distributed systems 会“help significantly”；Cornell CS5412 把 distributed systems 列为可接受背景
Cornell CS5412 假定 solid background doing systems programming。

notes: C.4.1 记 recommended 而不是 supported：两门课都只说“学过分布式系统有帮助/是常见背景之一”，没有写成硬性先修。C.2.3（虚拟化、容器与资源管理）判 not_mentioned：Cornell CS5412 与 Tufts CS 118 都把虚拟机和容器当作课程内容来讲（Tufts 有 'Virtual machines & containers' 两讲），不是先修要求。Cornell CS5412 的先修原文写在 FAQ.html（首页只有引导语），已核实。
